_README: External dielectric constants for the Wannier-Mott exciton binding (Theme I, option c). Values ONLY from cited sources (no fabrication). Web research done by Claude Code per PI instruction 2026-05-24 ('webresearch自分でやって').
_KEY_FINDING: Web research shows the literature reports the BARE electronic eps_inf, but the Wannier-Mott exciton needs the EFFECTIVE screening eps_eff (between eps_inf and eps_static, including phonon contribution). Bare eps_inf OVERESTIMATES E_b: e.g. CsPbCl3 eps_inf=2.4 -> E_b=273 meV vs experiment 64 meV (Baranowski et al., Photonics Research 8, A50 (2020), magneto-optical; OA-verified bibliography+value; note Tanaka 2003 SSC 127,619 is MAPb not CsPbCl3); whereas the effective eps=6.1 for CsPbI3 gives E_b=22 meV (within experimental range 7.4-50 meV, Cho 2019 arXiv:1908.09436 [in-repo PDF, verified]; Cho's own mu=0.10 gives 37 meV). So absolute E_b for the lead-free family cannot be reliably computed from bare eps_inf; eps_eff data is only available for CsPbI3-type. Reliable, consistent cubic-phase eps for all 9 is NOT available via open web (paywalled / phase-mismatched / method-scattered) -> Materials Project DFPT (one method) or experimental exciton eps_eff would be needed.

CsPbI3.source: Cho et al. 2019 arXiv:1908.09436 (effective exciton eps=6.1); crystal static eps~6.22 reported by thin-film optical study (ScienceDirect S1876107018306059); MAPbI3 eps_p=6.1 (arXiv:2210.01324)
CsPbI3.method: effective exciton dielectric (eps_eff), multiple converging sources
CsPbI3.notes: PHYSICAL: E_b=22 meV is within the experimental range 7.4-50 meV (Cho 2019 arXiv:1908.09436; Cho's own mu=0.10 gives 37 meV). eps=6.1 is the effective exciton screening (2D inorganic-layer value; bulk transfer is approximate), not bare eps_inf.

eps_inf_MP_DFPT.phase_note: no Pm-3m dielectric in MP; lowest-Ehull phase with a DFPT dielectric used (eps_inf ~phase-insensitive; mu is cubic-phase)

CsPbCl3.source: PMC12757862 (LST: eps_inf=2.40, eps_static=7.2); PMC9071989 (eps~2.513 from real part of eps(w), DFT TB09)
CsPbCl3.notes: BARE eps_inf, NOT eps_eff. E_b(2.4)=273 meV >> experiment 64 meV (Baranowski et al., Photonics Research 8, A50 (2020), magneto-optical; OA-verified; Tanaka 2003 SSC 127,619 is MAPb not CsPbCl3) -> bare eps_inf overestimates E_b. Back-solving exp E_b~64 gives eps_eff~5.0. Do NOT use bare 2.4 for physical E_b.

eps_inf_MP_DFPT.phase_note: no Pm-3m dielectric in MP; lowest-Ehull phase with a DFPT dielectric used (eps_inf ~phase-insensitive; mu is cubic-phase)

CsPbBr3.note: Should lie between CsPbCl3 and CsPbI3 (Cl<Br<I) ~ eps_eff 3.5-4.5; no clean cited cubic eps_inf extracted (ellipsometry papers exist e.g. Ermolaev/Brennan on refractiveindex.info but n not extractable via fetch).

eps_inf_MP_DFPT.phase_note: no Pm-3m dielectric in MP; lowest-Ehull phase with a DFPT dielectric used (eps_inf ~phase-insensitive; mu is cubic-phase)
2 MP phases, none with a DFPT dielectric

CsGeI3.note: OSTI 1328304 / RSC c6ta04685a: CsGeI3 has LARGE static eps (lattice-dominated) but SMALL eps_inf; no eps_inf number given. PMC9833107 is rhombohedral, not cubic.

eps_inf_MP_DFPT.phase_note: no Pm-3m dielectric in MP; lowest-Ehull phase with a DFPT dielectric used (eps_inf ~phase-insensitive; mu is cubic-phase)

CsGeBr3.note: Springer s10904-025-03882-6 search snippet states eps_r(w)=5.72 for CsGeBr3 but paywalled (could not confirm whether this is eps_inf, static, or peak).

eps_inf_MP_DFPT.phase_note: no Pm-3m dielectric in MP; lowest-Ehull phase with a DFPT dielectric used (eps_inf ~phase-insensitive; mu is cubic-phase)

_KEY_FINDING_C: Option C' (Materials Project DFPT eps_inf): single-method, consistent across materials -> RELATIVE E_b trend is maximally defensible. BUT MP eps_inf is the BARE electronic dielectric (no phonon/ionic contribution), i.e. eps_inf < eps_eff, so absolute E_b is an UPPER BOUND (overestimate). Also MP computed the DFPT dielectric only for certain phases (cubic for some, ortho/rhombo/monoclinic for others); mu here is cubic-phase, so eps_inf is used as a ~phase-insensitive proxy (phase recorded per material). Key never stored; provenance = mp-id + URL only.
